g.text: Retrieve for coverage; synthesize for human attention
Evaluate evidence collection separately from the brief a person must review.

g.text: Test whether decisive sources are found, then whether compression preserves their meaning.More context does not establish a better answer; agents still need precision and people may need recall.

The reported workbench includes activity feeds, “What am I missing?” and evidence-backed summaries.Assess relevance, omissions, timeliness and review time against the existing information flow.These examples establish no changed habits, predictive accuracy, optimal settings or investment returns.
Source: Bridgewater Vault notes. Human/agent contrast is a workload heuristic, not a universal rule.
